name: year
description: Reference year of the survey period

name: state_id
description: Two-digit FIPS state code

name: county_id
description: Five-digit FIPS county code, state code followed by county code

name: place_id
description: Seven-digit FIPS place code, state code followed by place code
observations: Published from 2008 only. Null for the roughly 28 percent of permit offices that are minor civil divisions or county-part records rather than places, and for the balance-of-state sentinel the source writes as 99990. Where present it matches the 2020-vintage place directory for 99.6 percent of offices

name: mcd_id
description: Seven-digit FIPS minor civil division code, state code followed by MCD code
observations: Published from 2008 only. Identifies township and other minor civil division permit offices, which have no FIPS place code

name: cbsa_id
description: Five-digit Core Based Statistical Area code
observations: Published from 2005 only, when CBSA codes replaced MSA/PMSA codes. Null where the source publishes 99999

name: csa_id
description: Three-digit Combined Statistical Area code
observations: Published from 2005 only. Null where the source publishes 999

name: msa_cmsa_id
description: Four-digit Metropolitan or Consolidated Metropolitan Statistical Area code
observations: The pre-2005 code system, superseded by cbsa_id. Null from 2005 on

name: pmsa_id
description: Four-digit Primary Metropolitan Statistical Area code
observations: The pre-2005 code system, superseded by cbsa_id. Null from 2005 on and where the source publishes 9999

name: permit_office_id
description: Six-digit Building Permit Survey identifier of the permit-issuing office, unique within a state and survey period
observations: The Census Bureau assigns this code to sort offices alphabetically within a state, so it is reassigned when offices are added and is not stable over time. Addison village, Illinois, is 001000 in 1988 and 002800 from 1995. Do not use it to build a panel; use place_id or mcd_id

name: census_place_id
description: Four-digit Census place code
observations: Published from 2000 only. A Census Bureau internal place code, not the FIPS place code

name: region_id
description: Census region code, from 1 to 4

name: division_id
description: Census division code, from 1 to 9

name: structure_type
description: Type of residential structure, by the number of housing units in the building
observations: Census structure type codes: 101 single-family, 103 two-family, 104 three- and four-family, 105 five-or-more-family. Summing the four codes reproduces the published total for the geography

name: place_name
description: Name of the permit-issuing place or office, as published

name: central_city
description: Whether the place is a central city of a metropolitan area

name: footnote_code
description: Whether the place carries an explanatory footnote in the source release
observations: The footnote text itself is published in a separate monthly file, not loaded here

name: zip_code
description: ZIP code of the permit office or official

name: population
description: Population of the place as carried in the source file
observations: The Census layout document labels this the 2000 population, but the values change from release to release, so it is a current population estimate. Published from 2008 only

name: months_reported
description: Number of months of the year for which the permit office reported residential data

name: buildings
description: Number of buildings authorized by building permits
observations: Estimate with imputation: reported data for responding permit offices plus imputed data for non-respondents. This is the series to use by default

name: units
description: Number of housing units authorized by building permits
observations: Estimate with imputation: reported data for responding permit offices plus imputed data for non-respondents. This is the series to use by default

name: valuation
description: Construction valuation of the buildings authorized, in US dollars
observations: Estimate with imputation: reported data for responding permit offices plus imputed data for non-respondents. This is the series to use by default

name: buildings_reported
description: Number of buildings authorized, counting reporting permit offices only
observations: Reported only: counts data from responding permit offices and makes no imputation for non-respondents. Lower than the estimate with imputation

name: units_reported
description: Number of housing units authorized, counting reporting permit offices only
observations: Reported only: counts data from responding permit offices and makes no imputation for non-respondents. Lower than the estimate with imputation

name: valuation_reported
description: Construction valuation of the buildings authorized, in US dollars, counting reporting permit offices only
observations: Reported only: counts data from responding permit offices and makes no imputation for non-respondents. Lower than the estimate with imputation
